```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(openxlsx)
library(knitr)
```

##Pull in compiled data and export annual files
```{r Pull in compiled data files, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}

#write out a csv of all the data to the main folder: 
final_data <- read.csv("../COMPASS_SynopticCB_SGAS_AllData.csv")

##Separate by year for ESS-DIVE 
final_data_2023 <- subset(final_data, Year == "2023")
final_data_2024 <- subset(final_data, Year == "2024")

##Write out annual data files
write.csv(final_data_2023, "Data package/COMPASS_SynopticCB_SGAS_2023.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(final_data_2024, "Data package/COMPASS_SynopticCB_SGAS_2024.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

##Create dd file
```{r make metadata, include = FALSE}

#pull the column names from the all_dat1 dataframe and create a new dataframe with them
dd <- data.frame(Column_Names = colnames(final_data))
dd

dd$Unit <- ""
dd$Definition <- ""
dd$Column_Long_Name <- dd$Column_Names
dd$data_type <- ""
dd$Instrument_ifapplicable <- ""

#add information about each line:

dd$Definition <-  c("Project name",
                         "Region samples originated from: CB = Chesapeake Bay",
                         "Sample identifier used in laboratory and field",
                         "Year (YYYY) of sample collection",
                         "Month (#) of sample collection",
                         "Name of sampling transect location (GCW, SWH, MSM, GWI), see dataset locations for coordinates",
                         "Zone within space-for-time transect (UP=Upland, SWAMP=Swamp, TR=Transition, WC=Wetland Control, SW=Surface Water)",
                         "Soil gas well or sample grid replicate id (A-C, ATM for Atmospheric sample, Letter+Number for GCW UP (TEMPEST Site))",
                         "Depth in centimeters from which water sample was taken",
                         "Machine on which gas sample was analyzed", 
                         "Methane concentration in ppm, corrected for dilution",
                         "Methane concentration flag base on standard curve (bdl=below detection limit, adl=above detection limit)",
                         "Carbon dioxide concentration in ppm, corrected for dilution",
                         "Carbon dioxide concentration flag base on standard curve (bdl=below detection limit, adl=above detection limit)")

dd$Unit <-             c("NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "cm",
                         "NA",
                         "ppm",
                         "NA",
                         "ppm",
                         "NA")

dd$data_type <-        c("text",
                         "text",
                         "text",
                         "numeric",
                         "text",
                         "text",
                         "text",
                         "text",
                         "numeric",
                         "text",
                         "numeric",
                         "text",
                         "numeric",
                         "text")

dd$Instrument_ifapplicable <-

                       c("NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "NA",
                         "Varian Gas Chromatograph",
                         "NA",
                         "Varian Gas Chromatograph",
                         "NA")


#write out the data dictionary associated with the data:
write.csv(dd, "Data package/dd.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```


##Create flmd file
```{r}

files  = list.files("Data package")

flmd <- data.frame(file_name = files)
flmd

flmd$file_description <- ""
flmd$standard <- ""
flmd$file_version <- ""
flmd$data_orientation <- ""
flmd$header_rows <- ""
flmd$column_or_row_name_position <- ""
flmd$notes <- ""

#add information about each line:

flmd$file_description <-  c("Soil gas well data taken from COMPASS synoptic sites in 2023",
                            "Soil gas well data taken from COMPASS synoptic sites in 2024",
                            "Data dictionary file for COMPASS_SynopticCB_SGAS_2023.csv and COMPASS_SynopticCB_SGAS_2024.csv describing each column in the dataset")

flmd$data_orientation <-  c("horizontal",
                            "horizontal",
                            "horizontal")

flmd$header_rows <-   c("1",
                        "1",
                        "1")

flmd$column_or_row_name_position <- c("1",
                                      "1",
                                      "1")


#write out the flmd associated with the data:
write.csv(flmd, "Data package/flmd.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
